title: 不情愿地做产品化代理，两年做到年入百万
title_en: Reluctantly Built a Productized Agency, Hit $1M/Year in Two Years
title_jp: 不本意ながら製品化エージェンシーを構築、2年で年商100万ドル
title_ar: بنى وكالة منتجة على مضض، حقق مليون دولار سنويا في عامين

{"ops": [{"insert": "不情愿地做产品化代理，两年做到年入百万"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他说：我本不想做代理，但现在觉得这被低估了", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Corey Haines从19岁就知道想成为entrepreneur。所以intentionally开始build up skills和experience。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "给几个startups做marketing。Also lot of consulting。Built newsletter叫Swipe Files，聊很多different marketing strategies。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不知道想start什么kind of business……只知道两件事："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Wanted to start something", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Did NOT want to start marketing agency", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "But then，got laid off。Nothing like losing job、只有几个月savings来get motivated figure something out。Since couldn't code当时、having hard time finding technical cofounder，decided finally embrace idea of starting agency。Just made sense because of experience、always turning away work的事实。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Started "}, {"insert": "Conversion Factory", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " in July 2023和两个friends。SaaS marketing和设计agency，completely asynchronously work on productized model。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "两个月内，月入3.6万美元——necessary因为只有两个月savings。现在，"}, {"insert": "annualized run rate超过100万美元（约700万人民币）。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "因为这个agency，现在also able learn to code、build couple SaaS products that going well。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "和两个cofounders一周内 whipped up landing page，然后spun up所有processes和documentation on the fly as got clients。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Lot of "just-in-time" learning。Thankfully，since providing service not product，could go to market very quickly。Launch两周内有了first client——signed up、pain money without even hopping on call beforehand。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Spun up simple client dashboard in Notion with Kanban-style task board，invited client，然后had first deliverable turned back within hour。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Big emphasis on service："}, {"insert": "not putting in corner with hourly或project-based pricing。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " 唯一会做marketing和设计agency的方式是if had productized pricing和service model。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Worked with ton of different agencies、consultants、freelancers as marketer in-house for startups，seeing all different ways working relationship can break down with traditional service model。Tried design everything about Conversion Factory be antithesis of what didn't like，be perfect combination of features would want if still working in-house at startup。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这包括strict asynchronous work style with no meetings、no emails、no Slack with clients。唯一例外是couple one-off workshop-style calls for bigger projects。Otherwise，designed pricing essentially like subscription to product with simple workflow provide complete transparency around progress和collaboration on projects for clients。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "技术栈："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Website on Webflow，most client sites on Webflow或Framer", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Stripe for billing，Mercury for banking", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Plane for payroll和contractor management", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每个client own Notion dashboard，meticulously designed和refined over time", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Zapier glue between quite few tools、automating processes within Notion", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Internal comms用Slack", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Updates通常accompany with Loom videos和AI-generated summaries", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "SavvyCal for sales call scheduling，Grain for call recording", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Figma design tool of choice", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Optibase for A/B testing和experimentation on Webflow sites", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Typefully for social media scheduling", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Fathom Analytics for web analytics", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Heavy users of ChatGPT speed up copywriting和editing", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "About year in，两个cofounders都within week of each other going on paternity leave。Super stressful time because hadn't hired anyone yet。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Filling in for each other、making sure work got done while someone trying enjoy time off是kick in the butt——但needed kick in the butt start growing和scaling team。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Hit 3.6万MRR in 2个月。三个原因："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Past consulting的pent-up demand", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "X上built的audience（2万+ followers）和LinkedIn", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Newsletter Swipe Files，约3万subscribers——all SaaS marketers和founders", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Since then，lot of time和money："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Going to meetups和conferences（一年去了13个！）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Sponsoring newsletters和podcasts", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Doing outbound emails（yes，can be done without being super spammy）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Investing in SEO。Takes time，but well worth it。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Service businesses driven by relationships和expertise，所以try make sure do anything helps build one或both of those。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "六、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Charge on fixed plans on Stripe subscriptions。Essentially retainers with specific productized workflow，start at $6000 per month，go up depending on work rate和number of concurrent tasks clients want work on。Also add-on services是additional subscriptions。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Clients pay $6000到$20000 per month depending on core plan和/或add-ons。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Biggest growth drivers之一是increasing ACV of clients。Changed pricing several times、gone through many different iterations和packages offer。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Another thing worked really well：offering $1000 audit，allows deliver quick win to prospective client、outline all work can do for them in future，as well as get familiar with working relationship和expertise。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "七、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2018年开始做products——ebooks、courses到software和consulting。Always looking for something provide full-time living，so could work on creative projects和其他things might have more upside but take longer time bootstrap。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Always resisted idea of starting agency或service business。但现在in it、had success with it，just seems so obvious as something very fulfilling和rewarding。Also allows open up as much time as want work on other products。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""Think very underrated to go all in on productized service或agency。Then can take all earnings from that business into whatever want build next。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Highly recommend reading Rob Walling's blog post on "The stair-step method of bootstrapping。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Then dive into other productized businesses。Studied lot of them before launching Conversion Factory。Listen to podcast interviews with founders，peruse websites，go through forums和Slack channels，hear what people have say about them。Even DM'd、talked with few other agency owners in other industries。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Corey的故事是关于embracing what you resist——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Didn't want agency。Ended up with $1M+ ARR agency。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Key insights——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Productized model > Traditional agency", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Async work style is possible", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Your audience/newsletter is your unfair advantage", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "$1k audit as lead magnet works", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Agency can fund your other products", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最重要的是，"}, {"insert": "he changed his mind。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "That's growth。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: Reluctantly made productized agency two years achieved million annual. He says I did not want to do agency but now think it is underestimated. Corey Haines knew at 19 wanted to become entrepreneur. So intentionally started building up skills and experience. Did marketing for several startups. Also lot of consulting. Built newsletter called Swipe Files talking about many different marketing strategies. Did not know what kind of business to start only knew two things: wanted to start something did NOT want to start marketing agency. But then got laid off. Nothing like losing job only months savings to get motivated to figure something out. Since could not code at that time having hard time finding technical cofounder.
content_jp: 不情愿にproductized agencyをやり、2年で100万年収を達成.曰く:agencyをやりたくなかった今，觉得被低估了. Corey Hainesは19歳で entrepreneurになりたいと分了. So意識的にskillsとexperienceをbuild up. いくつかのstartupsのmarketingをした. lots of consultingもした. Swipe Filesというnewsletterを作营销策略について话した. 어떤 종류의 бизнес를 시작할지 몰랐습니다두 가지만 알았습니다: 무언가를 시작하고 싶었습니다marketing agency를 시작하고 싶지 않았습니다. 그때 해고されました.失业して、数ヶ月のsavingsだけでmotivateされて、何とかやりくり.その时codeができなかったからtechnical cofounderを見つけるのが大変だった.
content_ar: بشكل غير راغب сделал агентство متجنس في عامين حقق مليون سنوي. он говорит: я не хотел делать агентство но теперь думаю что оно недооценено. Corey Haines عرف في سن 19 أنه يريد أن يصبح رائد أعمال. لذلك بدأ عمداً في بناء المهارات والخبرة. فعل تسويق لعدة شركات ناشئة.还有很多 استشارات. بني النشرة تسمى Swipe Files تتحدث عن العديد من استراتيجيات التسويق المختلفة. لم يعرف أي نوع من الأعمال يريد البدء فيه فقط عرف شيئين: يريد أن يبدأ شيئاً لا يريد أن يبدأ وكالة تسويق. لكنه then تم تسريحه. مثل فقدان الوظيفة仅有的 أشهر مدخرات لـ motivate找出路. بما أنه لا يستطيع البرمجة في ذلك الوقت كان من الصعب finding مهندس مشارك.
